summary: The study investigates the ALD process for depositing Al2O3 on NH42S passivated GaAs(100) surfaces using trimethyl aluminum (TMA) and water as precursors. The process involves half-cycle exposures and in situ XPS analysis to study surface reactions. The results show that trivalent oxides are reduced, while suboxides remain unaffected, and sulfur bonding is modified during the ALD process.
evidence: The ALD chamber pressure was 7.6 Torr during deposition, and film depositions were performed at sample/reactor temperatures of 300 °C.
